export.how: the pinned upstream safetensors; every BatchNorm folded into the convolution before it in float32 (Math.fround at each step); the ONNX graph (opset 17) written from models/image-role-spec.json, which holds the structure and no weight; the classifier is not part of it: the file emits the 1280-value pooled embedding
export.spec: models/image-role-spec.json (derived once by research/analyzer-source-01/encoder_spec.py from a torch export)

license.notice: MobileNetV4-conv-small weights from timm (Ross Wightman, Hugging Face), Apache-2.0 per the model card read 2026-11-03; trained on ImageNet-1k, whose own terms are research-oriented — the same caveat IU-01 recorded for every ImageNet trunk. The file is a format conversion of those weights with the classifier removed.
